description: This file contains C source code for conversion between IEEE floating point formats—double, single, and half precision. It provides functions to convert 32-bit integers or floats to 16-bit half-precision representations and vice versa, handling special cases such as zeros, infinities, and NaNs.

methods.name: void lws_singles2halfp(uint16_t * hp,uint32_t x)
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit float in IEEE format to 16-bit half-precision format stored in a uint16_t pointer.

methods.name: void lws_halfp2singles(uint32_t * xp,uint16_t h)
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit half-precision floating point stored in uint16_t to a 32-bit IEEE float representation in a uint32_t.
